title: Quentin and the Current
premise: Salvage diver Mirabel Underhill takes a dying prospector's map in exchange for a promise to find his daughter, and discovers the wreck she's been diving is a navy cover-up guarding the river's source — a spring that yields a metal worth killing for. Following the river upstream with a disgraced navy cartographer, Quentin Hale, she learns her own father died protecting the same secret. At the source, Mirabel must choose between exposing the truth and honoring the promise, and she chooses truth, flooding the operation, saving the daughter, and paying with the only life she knew.
about_author: S. M. Thackeray is the pen name of a former merchant-marine deckhand who spent six seasons on inland waterways before turning to fiction. Their novels are known for river-country settings, morally tangled loyalties, and protagonists who measure life in miles rather than years.

chapters.title: Ten Fathoms, No Answers
chapters.summary: Mirabel dives a navy-cordoned wreck, finding a sealed strongbox stamped with a river-source insignia. POV Mirabel. Beat: restless competence masking a decade of unanswered grief about her father's disappearance on that same river.

chapters.title: The Dying Man's Bargain
chapters.summary: A prospector washes into her salvage yard, shot and half-drowned. He trades a hand-drawn map upstream for her promise to find his daughter, Wren, then dies. POV Mirabel. Beat: the promise made before she understands its cost.

chapters.title: Navy at the Door
chapters.summary: Lieutenant Commander Ashford's men search her yard for the map. Mirabel hides it in a dive tank and lies for the first time in years. POV Mirabel. Beat: the moment loyalty to truth begins costing her the law's protection.

chapters.title: Quentin Hale, Cartographer
chapters.summary: A drunk ex-navy mapmaker recognizes the insignia on her copied sketch and begs in. He was cashiered for charting the forbidden source. POV Quentin. Beat: two broken people recognizing each other's exile.

chapters.title: Upstream
chapters.summary: They launch a patched riverboat past the navy checkpoint using Quentin's old credentials. First rapids, first trust. POV Mirabel. Beat: the river becomes a character — beautiful, indifferent, armed with secrets.

chapters.title: The Burned Village
chapters.summary: A riverside settlement razed by navy 'survey teams'; a survivor tells of men in diving suits hauling metal from the spring. POV Mirabel. Beat: the promise gains witnesses and weight.

chapters.title: Wren's Trail
chapters.summary: Evidence the prospector's daughter went upstream weeks ago, leaving coded marks her father taught her — marks Mirabel can read. POV Quentin. Beat: hope sharpens into urgency as they realize someone else hunts Wren.

chapters.title: The Toll Keeper
chapters.summary: A smuggler queen controls the gorge passage; she knew Mirabel's father and reveals he died at the source, not in an accident. POV Mirabel. Beat: grief reframed as inheritance — she's finishing his journey.

chapters.title: Ashford Closes In
chapters.summary: Ashford's gunboat shadows them; Quentin burns his old charts to buy a night's head start, destroying his life's work. POV Quentin. Beat: sacrifice as proof of changed loyalty.

chapters.title: White Water
chapters.summary: A catastrophic rapid swamps the boat; Mirabel dives to free a fouled rudder in freezing current, nearly drowning. POV Mirabel. Beat: the river exacts its price; survival stops being free.

chapters.title: The Metal That Sings
chapters.summary: They recover a fragment of the source-metal: it hums and warps compasses. Quentin explains the navy's weaponization program. POV Quentin. Beat: wonder curdles into dread — this is why people die.

chapters.title: Prisoner of the Survey Camp
chapters.summary: Captured by Ashford's forward camp, Mirabel is offered her father's file in exchange for the map. She reads it. POV Mirabel. Beat: temptation of official truth versus the promise.

chapters.title: The Long Swim
chapters.summary: Mirabel escapes through a flooded mine shaft only a diver could survive, leaving Quentin captured as deliberate bait. POV Mirabel. Beat: the ugliest choice yet — using a friend.

chapters.title: Wren Found
chapters.summary: Mirabel finds Wren hiding above the treeline, alive but hardened, holding her father's letters and a grudge against promises. POV Wren. Beat: the promise becomes a person with her own will.

chapters.title: Exchange at the Weir
chapters.summary: Ashford trades Quentin for the map; Mirabel hands it over — it's a decoy she redrew. POV Quentin. Beat: loyalty tested and repaid; the deception buys one day, not safety.

chapters.title: The Last Mile of River
chapters.summary: The three climb the source canyon as Ashford realizes the forgery and pursues. POV Mirabel. Beat: rising dread; the river narrows and so do the options.

chapters.title: The Source
chapters.summary: The spring: a cathedral cavern where the metal grows in the current, and where her father's dive gear still lies. POV Mirabel. Beat: awe and grief fused; answers arrive heavier than questions.

chapters.title: Ashford's Argument
chapters.summary: Ashford arrives not with guns first but with logic: the metal could end wars or fuel them; the navy chose. He offers Mirabel her father's legacy. POV Ashford. Beat: the antagonist becomes almost reasonable — corruption wearing conviction.

chapters.title: What the Water Keeps
chapters.summary: Mirabel breaches the cavern's roof with demolition charges, collapsing the spring into the deep aquifer — the metal becomes unreachable, the secret worthless. POV Mirabel. Beat: climax; truth delivered as destruction.

chapters.title: The Reckoning
chapters.summary: Ashford, ruined by the loss, lets them go rather than report failure; Quentin chooses exile over reinstatement. POV Quentin. Beat: the powerful choose pride; the powerless choose each other.

chapters.title: Miles, Not Years
chapters.summary: Mirabel, Wren, and Quentin run a small salvage outfit downstream, diving honest wrecks. Wren scatters her father's letters in the current. POV Mirabel. Beat: the price paid, and the life rebuilt on its far side.

chapters.title: The Current Goes On
chapters.summary: Epilogue: a navy diver surfaces at the sealed source and finds only Mirabel's father's compass, left deliberately — a message that someone knows. POV Wren. Beat: quiet, open-ended defiance; the truth survives underground.
